title: Zakura node
description: Metrics that zakurad 1.6.0 exports with the legacy P2P stack (docs/zakura-measurements.md). Each duration is a summary: the panels use the sum and the count.

panels.title: Block height
panels.description: zcash_chain_verified_block_height.

panels.title: Estimated network tip
panels.description: sync_estimated_network_tip_height: estimate from the time of the tip block and the clock. sync_estimated_distance_to_tip: blocks to that height.

panels.title: Height on disk
panels.description: state_finalized_block_height: the newest block in RocksDB. At the tip it is the tip minus the reorg window.

panels.title: Peers
panels.description: zcash_net_peers: ready and not ready peers of the legacy stack.

panels.title: Build
panels.description: zakura_build_info.

panels.title: Heights
panels.description: Committed tip, tip of the non-finalized state, full verifier, checkpoint verifier, height on disk.

panels.title: Blocks for each second
panels.description: Rates over 1 minute: committed blocks, blocks from gossip (downloaded, verified), blocks of the checkpoint verifier.

panels.title: Checkpoint verifier
panels.description: checkpoint_processing_next_height, checkpoint_queued_continuous_height, checkpoint_queued_max_height, checkpoint_queued_slots.

panels.title: Download queue
panels.description: sync_downloads_in_flight (tasks of the legacy syncer in download or in verification) and its parts.

panels.title: Sync stages
panels.description: sync_stage_duration_seconds: mean by stage.

panels.title: State in memory
panels.description: Chains and blocks of the non-finalized state, and queued blocks.

panels.title: Block commit (one sample for each block)
Contextual commit
panels.description: state_contextual_total_duration_seconds: initial contextual checks and the commit to the non-finalized state. Mean over the rate interval.

panels.title: Parts of the contextual commit
panels.description: Means of the parts of state_contextual_total_duration_seconds.

panels.title: Wait in the queue of the block writer
panels.description: state_block_writer_queue_duration_seconds: mean.

panels.title: Semantic commit
panels.description: state_semantic_commit_*_duration_seconds: means.

panels.title: Write to RocksDB
panels.description: zakura_state_rocksdb_batch_commit_duration_seconds: one sample for each finalized block. Mean.

panels.title: Batch verification
panels.description: zakura_consensus_batch_duration_seconds: one sample for each batch, blocks and mempool together. Mean by verifier.

targets.expr: sum by (verifier, result) (rate(zakura_consensus_batch_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (verifier, result) (rate(zakura_consensus_batch_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Verification cache
panels.description: zakura_consensus_cache_hit, _miss, _insert for each minute, and the cache size.

panels.title: Halo 2 proofs
panels.description: proofs_halo2_verified for each minute.

panels.title: Mempool size
panels.description: zcash_mempool_size_transactions and the queue of the downloader.

panels.title: Mempool bytes
panels.description: zcash_mempool_size_bytes and zcash_mempool_cost_bytes.

panels.title: Mempool transactions
panels.description: Transactions for each minute: queued, downloaded, pushed, verified, gossiped.

panels.title: Template and block submission
panels.description: mining_*_duration_seconds: means. preparation: the build of a template for a request. zakurad builds a template only for a request.

panels.title: Prepared block cache
panels.description: mining_prepared_cache_hits, _misses, _evictions and cancelled or coalesced template preparations, for each minute.

panels.title: RPC mean service time
panels.description: rpc_request_duration_seconds: mean by method.

panels.title: RPC requests
panels.description: rpc_requests_total for each second, by method and status.

panels.title: RPC errors and active requests
panels.description: rpc_errors_total for each minute, and rpc_active_requests.

panels.title: P2P bytes
panels.description: rate of zcash_net_in_bytes_total and zcash_net_out_bytes_total over 1 minute: all legacy messages.

panels.title: P2P messages
panels.description: zcash_net_in_messages and zcash_net_out_messages for each second, by command.

panels.title: Address book and handshakes
panels.description: candidate_set_* gauges, handshakes in flight, mean handshake time.

panels.title: RocksDB size on disk
panels.description: zakura_state_rocksdb_total_disk_size_bytes and zakura_state_rocksdb_live_data_size_bytes.

panels.title: RocksDB memory
panels.description: zakura_state_rocksdb_total_memory_size_bytes and zakura_state_rocksdb_block_cache_usage_bytes.

panels.title: RocksDB compaction
panels.description: zakura_state_rocksdb_compaction_pending_bytes and zakura_state_rocksdb_compaction_running.

panels.title: Sidecar of the machine (race_* metrics of the node-exporter of the variable). zakurad exports no process metric.
Container CPU
panels.description: rate of race_node_cpu_seconds_total over 1 minute: CPU cores of the cgroup v2 of the node container (slice race-<node>.slice). Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: Container memory
panels.description: race_node_memory_bytes (memory.current) and race_node_memory_peak_bytes (memory.peak) of the cgroup v2 of the node container (slice race-<node>.slice), with the page cache. Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: Container disk I/O
panels.description: rate of race_node_io_read_bytes_total and race_node_io_write_bytes_total over 1 minute: io.stat of the cgroup v2 of the node container (slice race-<node>.slice). Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: Data directory
panels.description: race_node_data_bytes: disk blocks of the data directory of the node (du), each 60 s. Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: Template served after a block
panels.description: race_last_block_template_served_seconds: first getblocktemplate answer of the RPC caller on the last block minus the commit time of the block on this machine. Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: Template transactions after a block
panels.description: race_last_block_template_transactions: transactions of the first answer without longpollid at or after the first answer on the last block. Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: getblocktemplate time on the client side
panels.description: race_rpc_getblocktemplate_seconds: mean time of a call without longpollid on the client side (rate of _sum / rate of _count over 5 minutes). The node metric rpc_request_duration_seconds has the wait of each long poll. Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: Block received to committed
panels.description: race_last_block_received_to_committed_seconds: trace row block_request_finish (on the wall clock through the clock calibration) to the log line 'downloaded and verified gossiped block', for the last gossiped block, and race_last_block_clock_error_seconds: the error of the calibration. Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: Machine CPU
panels.description: Share of the CPU time of the machine that is not idle. Source: node-exporter of the machine. The machine runs one node.

panels.title: Machine memory in use
panels.description: MemTotal minus MemAvailable. Source: node-exporter of the machine. The machine runs one node.

panels.title: Disk in use
panels.description: Used bytes of the file systems ext4, xfs and btrfs, one time for each device. Source: node-exporter of the machine. The machine runs one node.

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Bytes read and written for each second, whole disks only. Source: node-exporter of the machine. The machine runs one node.

panels.title: Machine network
panels.description: Bytes received and sent for each second, without the loopback and the Docker interfaces. Source: node-exporter of the machine. The machine runs one node.
